$comment: Acceptance criteria for GATE-1 (onboarding simulation, spec 57-60).
amendment_reason: Original criterion required file_exists conformance/fixtures/onboarding-a-greenfield, assuming fixtures would be committed trees. They are not: committing the trees let the parent repository's git remote leak into fixture A and produce a false roadmap candidate, so fixtures became declarative specs in fixtures/onboarding.json materialized into isolated temp repos. The criterion described an implementation that turned out to be wrong, not a lowered bar.
